TECHNICAL SKILLS
Hardware: Basics of Computer & Networking Hardware
Operating Systems: Windows, UNIX, AIX • Programming Languages: Java, C#.NET, JavaScript (React)
Databases: Oracle, PostgreSQL • GUI & Web Technologies: HTML, React.js • Automation & Data Tools: Alteryx, DOMO,

Apptio, JIRA, Rally Project & Collaboration Tools: ServiceNow, Confluence, Remedy, PuTTY, TOAD for Oracle, MS SQL

• Domain Expertise: Telecom, Investment
Banking, Payments & Financial Services
AREAS OF EXPERTISE
Agile Program & Project Delivery: End-to- end execution of enterprise programs using Agile, Scrum, and hybrid delivery frameworks across global teams. Cloud Migration & Modernization: Led successful migrations from on-premise infrastructure to Microsoft Azure, enhancing scalability and system reliability.

Automation & Workflow Engineering: Designed automated workflows using Alteryx and developed Java React applications for process efficiency and TBM data management. • Budgeting, Forecasting & Cost Optimization:
Managed multi-million-dollar portfolios through precise financial forecasting, cost control, and ROI-driven governance. Stakeholder & Client Management: Built and maintained strong partnerships with global clients like Mastercard, Credit Suisse, and AT&T, ensuring strategic alignment and delivery excellence. Scrum Leadership & Coaching: Facilitated Agile ceremonies and coached multiple Scrum teams and Product Owners, driving continuous improvement and Agile maturity uplift. • Risk & Compliance Governance: Conducted proactive risk assessments, managed change controls, and ensured adherence to ISO and PMO standards. Cross-Functional Team Leadership: Directed developers, QA, and DevOps engineers across distributed environments, fostering collaboration and accountability. Process Improvement & Delivery Optimization: Streamlined sprint planning, backlog management, and capacity planning to improve delivery predictability and team velocity.




Technical Program Management: Bridged

business and technology through strategic planning, requirement analysis, and technical oversight of high-impact IT programs. Data-Driven Decision Making: Utilized DOMO, Apptio, and JIRA dashboards for performance tracking, analytics, and executive reporting. Change & Transition Management: Drove successful project transitions from initiation to go-live with seamless knowledge transfer and zero disruption.

Recently served as a Senior Technical Program Manager at PRI India IT Services Pvt. Ltd., driving MasterCard’s global programs through effective planning, automation, and collaboration. Skilled in Agile leadership, stakeholder management, and large-scale data migrations including Rally → JIRA → DOMO → Apptio, ensuring seamless execution and strong business outcomes. raw_sections.experience:
Diensten Tech Limited (DTL) | Pune | Feb 2026 – Till Date
Directed cross-functional teams of developers, testers, and DevOps engineers to deliver complex software programs on time and within scope, driving seamless collaboration across IT and operations. Championed Agile transformation across the Desperados program, mentoring teams, refining sprint planning, and reducing cycle times to accelerate the market delivery of payment system integrations such as SWIFT.

Managed project risks—financial, operational, and delivery—through structured transparent stakeholder governance, proactive mitigation strategies, and communication. Evaluated emerging tools, providing recommendations to enhance delivery efficiency and technical innovation.

technologies and vendor
strategic
Senior Technical Program Manager PRI India IT Services Pvt. Ltd. | Pune | Oct 2023 – Oct 2025
(Client: Mastercard)
Roles & Responsibilities: •
Spearheading end-to-end program management for Mastercard’s enterprise initiatives, including requirement analysis, sprint execution, stakeholder alignment, and cross-functional coordination to deliver high-impact business outcomes within defined timelines and budgets.
Orchestrating Agile ceremonies, daily scrums, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives, to ensure seamless execution, proactive risk mitigation, & continuous process optimization across global teams. Formulating strategies for effective product backlog management, defining clear and actionable stories, and conducting grooming sessions to align teams with evolving business goals. Successfully migrated enterprise data and workflows across multiple platforms, from Rally to JIRA, JIRA to DOMO, and JIRA to Apptio, ensuring zero data loss, improved visibility, and consistent end-user access.


Designed and automated workflows in Alteryx, streamlining Mastercard product integrations between internal systems and third-party applications, significantly improving operational efficiency. Led the development of a TBM File Upload Application using Java React, enabling automated mapping of Mastercard Service-to-Product drivers for the finance team. Collaborated with client stakeholders to capture business and technical requirements for each PI cycle, finalized budget allocations, and maintained detailed capacity planning sheets to optimize resource utilization and delivery predictability. Implemented data-driven performance tracking and reporting dashboards, empowering leadership to make informed decisions and enhance product delivery velocity. Championed a culture of continuous improvement and transparency, mentoring teams to embrace Agile best practices and drive measurable productivity gains.




Starlink Technology OPC Pvt. Ltd. | Pune | Sep 2022 – Oct 2023
Roles & Responsibilities: • Directed cross-functional teams of developers, testers, and DevOps engineers to deliver complex software programs on time and within scope, driving seamless collaboration across IT and operations.
Managed a $10M portfolio of concurrent IT initiatives, overseeing agile sprint cycles, stakeholder alignment, and milestone tracking, achieving 98% on-time delivery and enhanced project visibility. Led comprehensive risk assessment, change control, and compliance processes adhering to ISO standards, while maintaining a 95% stakeholder satisfaction rate through proactive communication and transparent governance.

Optimized resource allocation and implemented dynamic backup protocols to minimize downtime during critical release windows, ensuring uninterrupted operations during major deployment phases. Championed Agile transformation across the Desperados program, mentoring teams, refining sprint planning, and reducing cycle times to accelerate the market delivery of payment system integrations such as SWIFT. Introduced automated project dashboards for real-time progress tracking and reporting, empowering leadership with actionable insights and decision-making. Fostered a culture of accountability, adaptability, and innovation, enabling faster response to business priorities and continuous improvement in delivery processes.



Nexwave , Pune Oct 2018 – Nov 2019 || Accenture, Pune , Nov 2019 – Sep 2022
GROWTH PATH Scrum Master (Technical Project Manager) | Nov 2019 – Sep 2022 Senior Software Engineer (Scrum Master) (Nexwave Payroll) | Oct 2018 – Nov 2019
Client: Credit Suisse | Project Budget: $10M
Roles & Responsibilities: •
Led the end-to-end transition of the Credit Suisse project from the JS–RJS phase to a live production environment as Transition Management Lead, ensuring zero downtime and smooth go-live execution.
Directed cross-functional teams comprising 10 developers, 4 QA engineers, and 4 DevOps specialists, driving Agile delivery excellence and adherence to the Definition of Done across all sprint cycles. Spearheaded cloud migration from on-premise infrastructure to Microsoft Azure, enhancing scalability & performance monitoring across environments.

Oversaw project budgeting, financial forecasting, and cost optimization, maintaining strict control on expenditures while achieving measurable ROI within the $10M portfolio.
Managed project risks—financial, operational, and delivery—through structured transparent stakeholder governance, proactive mitigation strategies, and communication. Coached and mentored multiple Scrum teams, elevating Agile maturity and fostering collaboration across engineering, QA, and DevOps to deliver continuous value. Facilitated Scrum ceremonies, conflict resolution, and sprint planning, ensuring all user stories were clearly defined, prioritized, and sprint-ready for development. Partnered with product owners to define roadmaps, refine backlog items, and align release goals with evolving business objectives. Resolved critical impediments and optimized team velocity through continuous improvement initiatives and adoption of Agile best practices. Evaluated emerging tools, providing recommendations to enhance delivery efficiency and technical innovation.
